subject: Pilot MAP framework & kickoff doc
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@altis.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot MAP framework & kickoff doc

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the discovery this morning. Attached are two items I promised: a concise MAP template (editable Google Doc) and a 6-slide kickoff deck you can share with stakeholders. I pulled the plan together to reflect the priorities you mentioned (data residency questions, latency targets, and integration with your ingestion pipeline).

High-level suggested timeline (we can compress or extend):
- Week 0 (Dec 15): Kickoff + environment access (test dataset + API keys)
- Week 1–2: Integration and smoke tests (sample prompts, latency checks)
- Week 3–4: Feature validation (edge cases, failure modes)
- Week 5: Acceptance window and scorecard review

If Altis wants a short pilot (30 days) we can treat Week 5 as the review/decision week. Proposed decision target: Dec 18 for kickoff confirmation so engineering can reserve a slot.

Next steps for you: review the MAP doc and the kickoff slides, then tell me whether Dec 15 works for your team or suggest an alternate kickoff date. I can also loop legal and procurement once you confirm timing.

Attachments:
- Altis-Pilot-MAP-Template.gdoc (editable)
- Altis-Pilot-Kickoff-Slides.gslides (6 slides)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

Lauren —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear timeline. This looks good. A few items from my side before we lock in the Dec 15 kickoff:
1) Procurement will need the commercial terms / a template SOW and estimated cost for the 30-day pilot (cc'd).
2) Our security team requested a short SCC questionnaire + evidence for SOC2 and data retention practices. Is that something Redwood can supply this week?
3) We prefer a tight 30-day pilot; Dec 15 kickoff is feasible on our end if procurement can sign off in the next week.

If procurement needs additional details, they can reach out to Jordan or Marissa directly.
